rows.en: Of course! You Gundams helped me out a lot, after all!!
So it's time to say goodbye.
Taro... So you're next...
It's a strange thing to say, but I wish I could have fought alongside all of you for longer.
...Would I get scolded for saying that? After all, it's best if there's no fighting at all.
Eradicating conflict takes power. And for that, you need comrades too.
That's true. I'm glad I got to meet you all. ...Well, I suppose I'd best be on my way.
...Looks like it's finally my turn.
Then hurry up and get back to her! Bet Methuss is getting lonely without you, huh!?
Yeah. The fighting goes on back in our own world too. We'll face it together.
Right! Give it your all!!
...Whoa, I'm next!?
Sempai, we're fading away too.
Looks like we're all vanishin' together.
Hey, hey, what's gonna happen to the DenLiner?
We can worry about that stuff once we're back!
You guys... thanks for everything...!!
Too bad I couldn't show you a little more of how cool I am!!
Well, so long!!
See you!
Take care of yerselves!!
Bye-byeee!!
...It seems I'm next.
Nu Gundam, 00, Wing Zero, Kamen Rider 1, W, OOO...
Zero, Brother Seven, Brother Ultraman... and Ankh, too.
These are good-luck charms I made! There's one for each of you.
...Hah? What the heck is this?
Look at it and remember me!! Even when we're apart, our hearts are one!!
Hmph... I'll take it, I guess.
Ankh, that's rude when he went to the trouble of making it! ...Mebius, thank you. I'll treasure it.
Yes! Let's all fight for peace in our own worlds, and never give in to evil!!
Well then, see you again someday!!!
Still, when did he find the time to make these?
Hahahahahaha...! That's Mebius for you!!
...Oh? Is this pattern the Fire Symbol? He's got good taste. I'll treasure it.
So this is a good-luck charm...!! They say wearing one brings you peace of mind!!
Fascinating!! Mebius, thank you!!
...!! What... is this sensation...!!
Wing Zero, looks like it's your turn.
So I can go back...
But I'll keep fighting. Until complete peace is achieved.
That is my "mission."
Looks like we're next, you know?
Whoa, here it is at last!!
Thank you, W. Your powers of deduction helped us out a great deal.
Hey, hey, cut out the thank-yous. We're comrades, aren't we?
Yeah, you're right.
Alright, once we're back, it's straight back to work. The requests have probably piled up sky-high.
Protecting Fuuto's no easy job.
It's almost time, you know?
Yeah, see ya! Until we meet again!
W, thank you so much!! You have no idea how reassuring it was when we met in the first Cube.
No, to me you're still a senior I can truly look up to!!
You think? I'm still a long way from being the real deal myself, though.
Well now, it seems my time has come as well.
Dad! Don't say it like that! You make it sound like you're dying!
Hahahahaha!! I thought I'd give you a little scare.
Haah... Knock it off. I'm not a kid anymore.
So it's finally goodbye, Seven.
It's sad to part when we'd only just met... but fighting beside you is a memory I'll treasure for life.
Yeah, me too.
Thank you. I'm grateful. ...Now then, farewell!!
It seems I can go back as well.
Take care, 00.
...Zero. I wanted to talk with you a little longer.
Yeah. For some reason, I felt like you and I would've gotten along, too.
Unfortunately, we're out of time...
Will you get to take it easy once you're back?
No...
We are Celestial Being. Those who seek the eradication of war...
We have to keep fighting...
For the future...!!
So it's goodbye to you as well, 00.
Nu Gundam... You're the Gundam among Gundams.
Seems every world's got it rough, huh.
Ankh! You're...!!
So it's here... You're going too, OOO. See?
You're right... Oh, everyone, thank you for everything.
...Hold on!!
I found this over there. Isn't this scrap of cloth yours, OOO?

notes.note: ALL ROWS: MainEventMess0930 #46-249 are never called by Event/Base/Command/0930.bla (it plays only #1-45, the pre-Belial briefing; offset+N -> entry N+1, verified). They are an earlier draft of the epilogue; the shipped epilogue is MainEventMess0931 (played by 0931.bla). No speakers exist for these rows; every speaker below is inferred from content and the 0931 equivalent. Identical/near-identical 0931 lines reuse story_190's English. This row: Black RX answering a Gundam's 'RX! Don't forget about us!' (#98).
Speaker unknown; likely Taro (his farewell block #101-106). #102 is someone else (casual 'anta') noticing Taro is next.
Taro (matches 0931 #14-15, Taro; #103-104 aligned with story_190's English for those near-identical lines). The second sentence is impersonal in the source; rendered 'it's best if'.
Speaker unknown; the 'eradicate conflict' wording suggests a Celestial Being Gundam (00). Impersonal 'you need' kept since the source subject is generic.
Zeta Gundam (Methuss already left in #50-53). #112/#114 are a rough-speaking ally (Zero/Momotaros/Shotaro style); speaker unknown.
Zeta. 'We'll face it together' = with Methuss and his comrades back home.
Den-O block: #118, 122-125 Momotaros; #119/126 Urataros; #120/127 Kintaros (Kansai); #121/128 Ryutaros, matching the 0931 order (#43-51). Trailing source line break dropped.
DenLiner spelled as in talk_004. Rows #118/123/124/126/128 reuse story_190's English for the identical 0931 lines #43/44/45/49/51.
Mebius block #132-141. #132 reuses story_190 (0931 #35); #160 matches story_190 (0931 #58). Trailing source line break dropped. #136/138 Ankh, #139 OOO (inferred from content).
Honorific -san after each name dropped per style; 'Kamen Rider 1' kept in full since the Japanese uses the full name here.
Man-niisan -> 'Brother Ultraman' as in story_060/061; Seven-niisan -> 'Brother Seven'.
Omamori -> 'good-luck charm' throughout.
Speaker unknown (rough voice). #143 speaker unknown (an Ultra elder, e.g. Ultraman/Seven).
Speaker unknown. Fire Symbol = Mebius's flame emblem. Mebius has already left, so 'He's got good taste.'
#147-148 read as Philip (W): 'interesting' and the lore-style explanation fit him; W was named as a recipient.
Wing Zero block #156-160. #157 speaker unknown (a fellow Gundam).
Kanzen heiwa -> 'complete peace' (Gundam Wing's complete-pacifism ideal).
W block: #169/176 Philip, #170/172/174/175/177/180 Shotaro. #171/#173 a thankful ally, speaker unknown.
#178-179 read as OOO (the junior Rider; uses 'ore'). 'W-senpai' -> 'W' per glossary (Sempai only for the Imagin). #179 answers a W line missing from this draft; 'No' kept.
Shotaro. Ichininmae -> 'the real deal' (full-fledged).
Seven. 'O-mukae ga kita' is a death euphemism; 'my time has come' keeps the double meaning Zero reacts to in #184.
Speaker unknown (an ally, e.g. Rider 1 / Nu Gundam). #189 likewise unknown.
Seven. 'Sekkaku deaeta noni' -> 'when we'd only just met'; fits the box after tightening.
00 block #195-207: #196/198/200 Zero, rest 00; #206 Nu Gundam (00 names him in #207).
Speaker unknown; read as Ankh's sardonic aside after 00's speech, just before OOO notices him fading (#212).
#215-216 Nu Gundam: OOO thanks 'Nu Gundam' in #219 for returning the cloth.

report: All 80 rows translated. MainEventMess0930 #46-249 are an unused draft epilogue (0930.bla plays only #1-45; the shipped epilogue is MainEventMess0931), so no script speakers exist; all speakers inferred from content and the 0931 version. Unattributed rows: 101, 102, 105, 112, 114, 142, 143, 146, 157, 171, 173, 187, 189, 211. Rows identical to 0931 (118, 124, 126, 128, 132, 160) reuse story_190's English; 103-104 aligned to the near-matches. No new names (DenLiner, Fire Symbol from canon).
